name: click-logger-three-pins
landmark: Three colored pins over US west coast
perspective: regional overview with three interactive pins
description: Place three large coloured point entities at known west-coast cities (Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles) and register a LEFT_CLICK handler on a new ScreenSpaceEventHandler that logs the picked entity's name and id whenever one is clicked. The test verifies the handler is wired up (programmatic checks) and the three pins are visible (screenshot).
prompt: Place three large point entities at Seattle (47.6062, -122.3321), San Francisco (37.7749, -122.4194), and Los Angeles (34.0522, -118.2437). Give them names 'Seattle', 'San Francisco', and 'Los Angeles' and distinct colours (CYAN, MAGENTA, LIME) with pixelSize 28 and a contrasting outline. Then construct a new ScreenSpaceEventHandler on viewer.scene.canvas and register a LEFT_CLICK input action that picks the scene at event.position and console.logs the picked entity's id.name when one was hit. Frame the camera over the US west coast with enough margin to include Seattle through Los Angeles, for example around 40.8 N, -121 W, 3,600,000 m altitude, or use a fitted rectangle.
expected_behaviors: Adds 3 viewer.entities with point graphics at Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles
Each entity has a name and a distinct large point (pixelSize >= 20)
Calls handler.setInputAction with a callback and ScreenSpaceEventType.LEFT_CLICK
Callback console.logs the picked entity's id.name when a hit occurs
Frames the camera over the US west coast (around 40-41 N, -121 W) at ~3-4 million m altitude or with a fitted rectangle
visual_expectations: A west-coast camera view of the US with three distinct large coloured points clearly visible: cyan in the Pacific Northwest, magenta in central California, lime green in southern California. The points should form a roughly vertical line down the coast. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

programmatic_checks.description: Picks the scene in the callback

screenshots.description: West-coast view with three coloured pins
